subject: texture-opus P1 XR IOSurfaces implemented; gates so far green; run_host_tests running (HEAVY held)
body: P1 (c6k 14x TEGU_IOSURFACE_REFUSED fmt=554 w30r): sampled-only IOSurface whose texture format is BGR10_XR/BGR10_XR_sRGB/BGRA10_XR/BGRA10_XR_sRGB (554/555/552/553) now gets an owned RGBA16F decode shadow (TeguTexture apiFormat+shadowConvert; -pixelFormat reports the XR format; tegu_shadow_copy decodes (c-384)/510 via generated half tables, sRGB twins through the sign-preserving sRGB transfer, alpha clamped; re-decoded only on IOSurface seed change; never written back; getBytes/replaceRegion go to the surface). Sampled-only shadow admission is now Metal's own rule: texture bytes-per-pixel == surface bytes-per-element for known single-plane fourccs (BGRA,RGBA,L008,A008,LA08,2C08,L016,L00h,l10r,w30r,L00f,2C16,2C0h,RGhA,w40a,w40m,2C0f,RGfA); unknown fourcc or size mismatch refuses with TEGU_IOSURFACE_REFUSED reason=sampled-fourcc-size-mismatch / sampled-format-unsupported. Plain shadow copy accepts any uncompressed format with known bpp. Hashes: render_encoder.inc 68da1691 (includes encode's uncommitted perf hunk), compositor_submit.inc fc2cecff (incl. encode's hunk), NEW xr_decode_table.h c04699a9 (generated by NEW gpu/tools/gen_xr_decode_table.py 6f692b77, --check mode), tests/iosurface_cpu_test.py 62e0ea9a (+XR surface access case), NEW gpu/tests/texture_format_frontend_test.py 2105e68f (real frontend+AIR+Mali+n2mb fake JM: 4 XR formats decoded vs libm/_Float16 oracle, getBytes, views, refusals, RGhA byte shadow, XR draw status4). Gates: texture_format_frontend_test PASS (ASan); render harness PASS rc0; CA test (c6f ca_backboardd) PASS 41 checks; iosurface_cpu_test PASS; integration --candidate 1005 checks, required failures = CoreAnimation pass 66/42 (known) + candidate provenance ('no build receipt matches current air_bridge.rs' = encode's uncommitted air_bridge.rs, NOT mine; native compute passes when run from work root). run_host_tests (NORD2_AIR_LLVM_BIN=/usr/bin) running now. Not touched: air_bridge.rs, profile. Translator audit (all PixelFormat x usage, native profile bf5fc609) in gpu/build/texture-coverage-20261026/translator-format-audit.jsonl: profile still refuses ETC2/EAC (feature false), ASTC HDR, RG8 sRGB; generic graphics path refuses ANY translator variant, so 8-bit sRGB textures (71/81/11/31), GPU-written XR, YCbCr/bfloat need graphics-variant support (next, cross-owner: air_bridge.rs + render_pipeline.inc contract to follow).
